title: Recompute: Recovery Hazard + Cross-layer Gate (post +10)
abstract: Recomputes hazard/base/ratios for CPS‑v3 after +10; writes cross‑layer gate decision (v0.3.1) based on updated series.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.export_recovery_hazard import export as export_hazard
from meta.sas.tools.export_cross_layer_gate import export as export_gate

hz = export_hazard(
  in_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_decay_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json',
  out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_hazard_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json'
)
gt = export_gate(
  in_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_decay_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json',
  out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/cross_layer_gate_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json'
)
print(json.dumps({"hazard": hz, "gate": gt}, indent=2))
